notes.title: v1.9: Cool quotes by Jeremy J Oertel!
notes.notes:
Jeremy wrote up a bunch of awesome quotes which will be displayed across the facility. Make sure you check them out at different times -- as the place gets closer to destruction, the quotes will reflect your approaching demise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43291147/2bb69a7e86b3c388ef7eac55f41b86d2e784d466.png[/img]

System Escape also has been updated to the latest Focus Engine v4.11.5

v1.9.1 fixes a UI render culling bug at certain angles.

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.8.1: More runtime options for troubleshooting
notes.notes:
I added an argument "simpletextures" that will disable automatic texture generation upon startup. This will make the game start up much faster. I did this to try and troubleshoot an issue here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2186670/discussions/0/3764479392873774240/

I don't think this issue is widespread, so all of you should still be able to use the "normal" options without a problem.

- Phr00t
